radical: 本文稿只讲解一个对象：DeckWeft 自己的导出流程。下一页先提出一个问题并给出回答，再让你把每个部分与整体对照着查看。
它按固定顺序经过四个部分：测量、修复、审阅和导出。在任何一个部分未通过的页面，都不会进入下一个部分。

radicalCodePoints.note: These strings are in the PDF, but some ideographs are mapped to CJK radical code points, so a viewer search for the ideograph may not find them.

pptx.scope: Package checks only: slide titles, alt text, decorative marking, reading order, language, links, notes and contrast. No screen reader or PowerPoint Accessibility Checker was run.

limits.note: Chromium maps each HTML <figure> to a /Figure that wraps the tagged image or chart; the inner figure has the alternative text.

pdf.scope: Structure checks on the PDF bytes. No screen reader or PDF/UA validator was run.

facts.title: 从页面到文件：DeckWeft 导出流程的四个部分

visualFidelity.reason: Reference renders by macOS Quick Look only; PowerPoint and Keynote were not run. Metrics are advisory; the contact sheets were viewed.

typography.scope: Run sizes after the uniform scene-to-slide fit, by role. Pass does not prove projection legibility, font availability or PowerPoint/Keynote rendering. Split or re-page a failing scene; the thresholds are not adjustable.

interactions.delivered: Blueprint A at diagram: the whole object with every part numbered and every explanation as text on the page.

fonts.note: Fonts are referenced by name, never embedded or redistributed. A machine without them substitutes another face.

powerpoint.detail: Only the user runs it; see applicationChecks.

keynote.detail: Only the user runs it; see applicationChecks.

quickLook.detail: macOS Quick Look (qlmanage, OfficeImport) drew each slide and PDF page as an independent reference render. It is neither PowerPoint nor Keynote.

applicationChecks.check: Open every .pptx in PowerPoint and in Keynote: no repair prompt, no import warning, every slide present.
applicationChecks.quickLook: Quick Look rendered every slide; it is not PowerPoint or Keynote.

applicationChecks.check: Use Edit Data on each native chart: the embedded workbook opens and holds the values the chart shows.
applicationChecks.quickLook: Not testable; the workbook was parsed independently and equals the chart caches.

applicationChecks.check: Ranked and grouped bars: the focused category is solid and the others pale with an outline (per-point fills).
applicationChecks.quickLook: Quick Look ignores per-point fills and draws every bar solid.

applicationChecks.check: Native charts: markers, dashes, value labels, end labels, first/last time labels and the value-axis steps.
applicationChecks.quickLook: Quick Look ignores markers, dashes, data labels, label skipping and the axis step.

applicationChecks.check: Charts with a missing value are images (L3) in this release. Before compiling them natively: in PowerPoint and Keynote a missing value must stay a gap on its own category, never zero, and later values must keep their categories.
applicationChecks.quickLook: Quick Look moves later values onto earlier categories when a point is omitted, and draws #N/A as zero.

applicationChecks.check: Headings and paragraphs wrap as on the web; negative letter-spacing is applied.
applicationChecks.quickLook: Quick Look ignores negative letter-spacing and wraps some 5–6 pt chrome text despite wrap="none".

applicationChecks.check: The fonts listed in the report are installed; otherwise the application substitutes them and line breaks change. Fonts are not embedded.
Free-form decorative shapes have the same colour as rectangles of the same value.
applicationChecks.quickLook: Quick Look draws free-form shapes slightly lighter than the stored colour.

applicationChecks.check: Run PowerPoint’s Accessibility Checker and a screen reader: slide titles, alt text, reading order, decorative marks, table headers.
Keynote: charts, tables, connectors and notes import as editable objects.
